CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship.
